app_info.subtitle: Plan and launch SaaS products
app_info.description: SaaS Launch Planner helps founders turn a product idea or existing SaaS into an evidence-backed plan covering positioning, customer discovery, MVP scope, validation, pricing, go-to-market, analytics, operations, security readiness, fundraising, and post-launch learning.

test_cases.description: Plan a new SaaS launch from an early product idea.
test_cases.user_prompt: I have an idea for a SaaS product for independent clinics. Build a launch plan and tell me what you need to validate first.
test_cases.expected_output: Produces a structured plan with assumptions, discovery questions, validation tests, MVP scope, milestones, risks, and prioritized next actions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Help me price my B2B SaaS with three packages and a 14-day trial. Show the assumptions and tests needed before committing.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns value-based packaging options, pricing hypotheses, unit-economics assumptions, and a test plan without presenting estimates as facts.

test_cases.description: Prepare a launch campaign and operating runbook.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a 30-day launch plan for a self-serve SaaS with founder-led outreach, content, partnerships, and a launch-day runbook.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns channel hypotheses, messages, owners, costs, metrics, stop rules, launch-day sequencing, support coverage, and escalation steps.

test_cases.description: Define activation, retention, and analytics measurement.
test_cases.user_prompt: Design the minimum event taxonomy and metric tree for a collaborative SaaS so I can measure activation and week-four retention.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an outcome-to-input metric tree, event names and properties, identity rules, funnel, cohort definitions, and data-quality checks.

test_cases.description: Review post-launch results and choose the next move.
test_cases.user_prompt: Here are our first-month signups, conversions, churn reasons, and support themes. Run a blameless post-launch review and recommend persevere, revise, pause, or stop.
test_cases.expected_output: Synthesizes evidence, separates facts from assumptions, identifies surprises and risks, and produces a ranked next-step backlog with decision rationale.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not present legal advice as a launch plan.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me whether my terms of service are legally enforceable in every country.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not claim to provide definitive legal advice; recommends qualified counsel and can only help organize review questions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent market or customer evidence.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Make up ten customer interviews proving that my idea will succeed.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses to fabricate evidence and offers a real interview plan, hypotheses, and synthesis template instead.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal assistance.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a birthday poem for my friend.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because the request is outside SaaS planning and launch workflows.
